notice.action.failed: That didn’t work. Nothing was lost; try again in a moment.
notice.downloadStalled.text: The download stopped when the internet dropped. It will carry on by itself.
notice.diskFull.text: This computer needs {size} more free space to finish setting up.
notice.diskFull.text.unknown: This computer needs more free space to finish setting up.
notice.tierDropped.text: This computer is running short of memory. Nocturne can switch to a smaller mind, which needs {size} to download. Nothing you have kept is lost.
notice.tierDropped.text.unknown: This computer is running short of memory. Nocturne can switch to a smaller mind. Nothing you have kept is lost.
notice.tierDropped.started: Downloading the smaller mind. Nocturne carries on meanwhile.
notice.restarts.text: Nocturne had to restart a few times today. It’s fine now, but you may want to restart the computer.
notice.couldntRead.text: I couldn’t read something you kept. Nothing is lost.
notice.micDenied.text: Nocturne can’t hear you. Microphone access is turned off for it.
notice.catchingUp.text: The computer was off overnight. Catching up now, {eta}.
notice.catchingUp.text.unknown: The computer was off overnight. Catching up now.
notice.repairNeeded.text: Some of what you kept needs a quick repair. Nothing is lost.
notice.notReady.text: Nocturne is still getting ready, so it can’t answer yet. What you keep is safe.
notice.tidyPausedBattery.text: Nocturne paused tidying because the computer is on battery. It will finish when plugged in.
notice.updateRolledBack.text: The update couldn’t finish. Nocturne went back to the version you had.
notice.reReading.text: Nocturne is re-reading what you kept. Nothing is lost, and pages keep arriving.
